description.english: Mangalavar Vrata is the Tuesday fast, primarily dedicated to Lord Hanuman, and also to Mangal (Mars) among the Navagrahas. Tuesday (Mangalavar) is considered Hanuman's special day — Hanuman is an embodiment of strength, devotion, and celibacy, and is believed to protect devotees from evil and negative energy. In some traditions, Tuesday is also dedicated to Goddess Durga and Lord Murugan (Kartikeya).
description.hindi: मंगलवार व्रत विशेष रूप से भगवान हनुमान को समर्पित है। हनुमान जी शक्ति, भक्ति और ब्रह्मचर्य के प्रतीक हैं।
description.telugu: మంగళవారం వ్రతం ప్రధానంగా హనుమంతునికి అంకితం. హనుమంతుడు శక్తి, భక్తి మరియు బ్రహ్మచర్యానికి ప్రతీక.

whatToEat: One meal in the evening (sunset or after)
Sweet red foods — jaggery, red sweets (red is Hanuman's color)

english: Wake up early, take a bath, and wear red or orange clothes (Hanuman's colors)
Visit a Hanuman temple in the morning — Tuesday morning visits to Hanuman are among the most auspicious acts
Offer sindoor (red powder), red flowers, red cloth, and boondi laddoos to Hanuman
Apply a tilak of sindoor from Hanuman's murti to your own forehead — receive his blessing
Recite Hanuman Chalisa 3, 7, or 11 times — this is the central prayer of the day
If possible, also read Ram Raksha Stotram
Fast throughout the day, breaking only after evening prayers
Light a ghee or sesame oil lamp before Hanuman in the evening
Feed the poor or donate red items and sweets in the evening

significance.english: Hanuman is the greatest devotee of Rama and is believed to be present wherever Ram's name is chanted. Fasting on Tuesdays is said to remove fear, bestow courage and strength, protect from evil spirits and black magic, reduce the malefic effects of Mars (Mangal) in the horoscope, remove obstacles in marriage and career, and grant the strength to overcome all difficulties. Hanuman never fails a sincere devotee.
significance.hindi: मंगलवार व्रत से भय नष्ट होता है, साहस और बल प्राप्त होता है। हनुमान जी की कृपा से बुरी शक्तियों से रक्षा होती है।
significance.telugu: మంగళవారం వ్రతంతో భయం నశిస్తుంది, ధైర్యం మరియు శక్తి లభిస్తాయి. హనుమంతుని అనుగ్రహంతో దుష్టశక్తుల నుండి రక్షణ లభిస్తుంది.
